af.footer.rodBroke: Rod broke · equipped a new one
af.help.autoRod: Equips the best rod from your bag when yours breaks or none is equipped. If off, fishing waits until you equip one yourself.
af.help.loginPopup: Closes the daily login card and reward popups when they appear, then resumes fishing after a moment.
af.help.pull: Once tension drops to this value, the rod is held again to keep reeling. Must stay below Release at. Default 8%.
af.help.release: While reeling, the rod is let go when the tension bar reaches this value, so the line doesn't snap. Lower is safer but slower. Default 25%.
